videos.why: The only ready Short by rank: Russia and Alaska flagged and labelled across the strait from frame 0 with a question a stranger can picture (driving over the sea), and a date-line payoff (drive east, arrive in yesterday) worth sending to a friend.
strengths: Two famous places named and flagged in the first frame, answer held back
The answer is on the map: two islands 3.8 km apart with the date line between them
The map spins round the globe so the two edges meet: a device we haven't used
risks: Close-ups of the strait are mostly sea with ice floes; land only at the edges
The payoff has no figure, a note from the number check
